data.scope: The one-call Short 1 replacement and the governed four-Short narration continuation only. No avatar, lip-sync, music, render, release or publication state changes.
data.method: Fresh immutable provider intent and receipt in narration-v3, exact output-format probe, the pinned tail-energy rule and a post-hold local HyperFrames Whisper diagnostic; no provider retry.
data.finding: The authorized replacement Short 1 Algieba guide returned HTTP 200 in the correct 24000 Hz mono 16-bit WAV format, but measured tail energy 0.0361, above the pinned 0.02 guide-completeness threshold.
data.diagnostic: Local Whisper recognized all 97 normalized words and the complete closing sentence. Its final-word timestamp ends at 41.21 seconds while media duration is 40.971 seconds, so it cannot prove the final phoneme is unclipped.
data.execution_state: Two cumulative Google guide calls, zero ElevenLabs transfers and zero retries. Cumulative estimated Google cost is 0.04178899999999999 USD.
data.policy_result: The fresh authorization allowed exactly one replacement and zero further retries. The batch remains stopped; no later guide or Original C transfer may be submitted without new exact owner authority.
data.limitations: Speech recognition supports that the full words are present but is not a perceptual listen and does not establish an unclipped final phoneme. No claim is made about Shorts 2 through 4 because their calls were not submitted.
data.recommended_next_action: Listen specifically to the replacement ending. If audibly complete, prefer a separately authorized local append-silence repair and re-probe over a third identical provider attempt. If clipped, revise the generation method before requesting any new provider call.
